status: Compared; visible implementation defects corrected; remaining differences documented. Not pixel-identical.

firebase.mode: Real SDK and DEV backend, screenshotMode disabled
firebase.synthetic_account_cleanup: Confirmed by deletion success assertion in both canonical before and final after runs
firebase.key_images: Attached only after account deletion; captured keys have been invalidated. Sketch QR is an explicitly invalid design example.

tested_behaviors: Direct login from account and Friends
Anonymous account creation and one-time key display
Account deletion and return to login

changes: Shared native bordered capsule button: removed redundant minimum height; approximately 68pt -> 50.333pt. Secondary tint replaces primary tint.
Email and key entry use native underlined fields and separate actions matching the intended structure.
Removed duplicate key-secured toolbar action; retained the body confirmation.
Account feedback excludes unrelated invitation errors.
Sketch references preserve linked iOS 27 library components; added native tab/news accessory instances, disabled actions and an editable representation of the official Google SDK button.
Updated Sketch wording and spacing to actual app states; retained separate email-sent variant. Current privacy copy follows the concurrent per-friend notes work.

comparison.before: comparison-before: original Sketch versus original native UI
comparison.after: comparison-after: revised Sketch versus final native UI
comparison.intermediate: comparison-to-original: intermediate corrected native captures versus original Sketch; retained for traceability
comparison.method: No input alignment, translation, scaling, blur, or per-element masks. Signed grayscale channels RGB=(max(sim-sketch,0),max(sketch-sim,0),max(sim-sketch,0)); only top 186 pixels masked. Separate unmasked RGB differences and 50% overlays. Contact sheets alone use 1x display thumbnails.

remaining_differences: Native large titles sit about 3pt below the library reference; native back-chevron tint differs on login subpages.

Actual List profile row is taller and has different avatar/text insets. Sketch keeps an illustrative LE badge; synthetic native account uses MP. Action label insets and synchronization disclosure also differ.
Standard native button fill remains 4-6 RGB levels darker than the Sketch library fill. Disabled-label contrast, fractional heights and font rasterization differ.
Apple SDK button uses native typography around 20pt versus the 17pt library approximation; Google shadow and label rendering differ slightly.
Tab and accessory glyph sizes/baselines, label weights, and glass rendering differ. Labels and symbols are retained in channel comparisons; glass material only is excluded from qualitative judgment.
News is live and rotates. Reference uses the observed public Programmheft headline; native captures show other live headlines with 40 unread items. No extra mask hides the content difference.
Secret-key and QR content intentionally differ. Sketch QR has a smaller graphic within a square white area; native uses a larger QR within a rounded, padded container.

The canonical before key capture is the replacement modal while the final after capture is the creation flow inside the tab navigation. This pair does not prove like-for-like full-screen before/after geometry.
